Name: Rush Orders - Continued
Author: recon88
Description:
[font=Arial][size=5]Overview[/size]
[size=2]Ever got tired of waiting for Clint or Robin to finish their jobs? 
With this mod, you can fast-track Robin's construction projects and Clint's tool upgrade services by spending extra Gold.
No more waiting days for your barn to be ready or your tools to return!
Whether you're in a rush to expand your farm or need your upgraded pickaxe ASAP, this mod lets you prioritize convenience and productivity.
Perfect for players who value efficiency or want to speed up their progress in Pelican Town.[/size]


[size=5]Use[/size]
[size=2]Clint's tool upgrades:
You can choose from normal upgrade (3 days, normal price), one day upgrade (1 day, 1.5x price) and instant upgrade (instant 2.0x price).

Robin's construction services:
After placing your construction or farmhouse upgrade, there will be the option the speed up the construction.
Each time you accept you have to pay 0.5x of the base price and it will reduce the construction process by one day.

Price factors can be configured. See below.[/size]


[size=5]Config[/size]
[size=2]Tool -> Rush: Price factor for finishing your Tool in 1 day
Tool -> Now: Price factor for finishing your Tool instantly
Building -> RushOneDay: Price factor for finishing your building one day earlier[/size][/font]

[code][font=Arial]{
  "PriceFactor": {
"Tool": {
"Rush": 1.5,
"Now": 2.0
},
"Building": {
"RushOneDay": 0.5
}
  }
}[/font]
[/code][font=Arial]

[size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/size][/font][/*]
[/list]
